feeds.description: If you're looking to learn how to cook, you've come to the right place. It's been 10 years teaching people online how to cook with easy recipes for those who want to learn. I also give tips and easy tricks on cooking.

feeds.title: Just Lia
feeds.description: Designer by training and blogger since 2000. Here on the blog, I talk about fashion, beauty, and lifestyle!

feeds.title: Panelaterapia
feeds.description: Panelatherapy has a rich collection of authentic recipes with a special touch by Tati Romano, illustrated with photographic production and videos by the influencer. Tatiana Romano lives in Sorocaba, left the profession of Psychologist and Teacher to dedicate herself to her passion for pots and Panel Therapy, which she has maintained since 2009.

feeds.title: Fashionismo
feeds.description: Thereza Chammas is from Rio de Janeiro and created Fashionismo 11 years ago. Here, people talk about fashion, beauty, decor, and behavior, always with a relaxed look and their own language! Fashionismo is an accurate radar that seeks to inspire, inform and empower those who love fashion and everything from the female universe!

feeds.title: Olivia's Cuisine
feeds.description: Hi, my name is Olivia and I'm the blogger, photographer and 'chef' behind Olivia's Cuisine. I am originally from Sao Paulo, Brazil, and I currently live in New York. This blog is meant to be a place where I express my adventures in the kitchen, a friendly place where readers can browse through my experiences and find /nurture their passion for cooking.

feeds.title: Easy and Delish
feeds.description: Hello! I am Denise Browning, I am a professional Chef with expertise in Brazilian food. I am also a busy mom of two girls, living in Texas. Here you will find budget-friendly, healthy Brazilian and Global Recipes made Easy and Delish! I would love to help you feed your family healthy dinners with a few splurges because life is all about balance! Join our community and happy cooking!

feeds.title: The Cookie Shop
feeds.description: The Cookie Shop is a mix of personal chronicles, recipes notebooks, and virtual candy store. The house specialties are decorated cookies and cookies, but Paula also ventures on decorated desserts and cakes, mixing sweets with art.

feeds.title: Brazi Bites Blog
feeds.description: I am Junea. I grew up in Brazil where the culture is rich and the food is fresh and delicious. Here I am sharing some of my favorite recipes and pieces of Brazilian culture so you too can bring a taste of Brazil into your home. I hope you enjoy!

feeds.title: Kalinka Carvalho Blog
feeds.description: Kalinka Carvalho is a Consultant, Speaker and Content Producer in Residential and Personal Organization.

feeds.title: Chata de Galocha!
feeds.description: What can make your life better? Moving around every day? A balanced diet? A peaceful sleep? Maybe an interesting trip, or a meal in a delicious restaurant? Watch that movie that moves us or travel through a book. The CDG's mission is to inspire you to have a better life, one day at a time.
